submission.justification: Absorber-F2 with 4 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.166% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. This material meets all project constraints: (1) it is one of the three candidate materials specified in candidate_specs.md, (2) it satisfies the radiation safety requirement for hands-on maintenance with a dose rate below 20 μSv/h at 1 m after one week of cooldown, and (3) the 4 mm thickness falls within the allowed 2-10 mm range. A systematic scan across all three materials (F1, F2, F3) at five thickness values (2, 4, 6, 8, 10 mm) confirms that F2 at 4 mm provides superior performance compared to F1's best of 4.902% at 6 mm and F3's best of 4.005% at 4 mm. This configuration delivers approximately 35% better resolution than the baseline F1 at 5 mm (5.1%) and represents the optimal design choice for the forward electromagnetic calorimeter.
